validations.message: La biblioteca maestra debe acercarse a 100 familias antes de entrenar el motor.
Cada familia debe tener 1 a 3 paquetes candidatos.
No hay evidencia directa JMC/Da Porto.

validations.outcome: No crear como familia operativa sin revisión
validations.message: Debe alimentar Contratos/PDC, no inflar Listado.
No calcular PDC sin duración configurada.
V1.0 requiere golden dataset con actividades del Programa General.

validations.outcome: Revisar patrones de familias antes de entrenar motor
validations.message: Cobertura estimada de patrones inferior al 30%. Ampliar text_patterns y aliases.
La biblioteca necesita al menos 5 familias operativas para listado-actividades.
Toda familia debe tener evidencia documental trazable.

validations.condition: JSON does not validate against schema_v1_0.json
validations.message: V1.0 debe pasar validación contra JSON Schema.

codex_instructions.instruction: Use biblioteca_maestra_pdc_v0_2 as source of truth for MasterCatalogService.
Do not infer packages from regex only; use family/package relations as evidence.
Keep contractual_only rows out of automatic create_activity unless user explicitly approves.
Expose evidence source and source_status in preview suggestions.
Do not auto-insert seed data into production DB; load read-only first.
Validate every family has 1-3 package candidates before enabling preview.
Use golden_dataset as training reference for pattern coverage analysis.
Run validate_biblioteca_maestra_v1.php before every engine integration change.
Coverage report must be regenerated when families or text_patterns change.
